1. Inspect legacy module: `git status --short && sed -n '1,40p' src/order_rules.py && grep -R "order_rules" -n services --include='*.py'`

3. Add public package API: `printf '%s\n' 'from .rules import calculate_total' '' "__all__ = ['calculate_total']" > packages/order_core/__init__.py`
4. Update six service imports: `grep -rl 'from order_rules import' services/{checkout,billing,inventory,shipping,notifications,reporting} --include='*.py' | xargs sed -i 's/from order_rules import/from order_core import/g'`
5. Remove legacy module: `rm src/order_rules.py`
6. Compile changed Python: `python3 -m compileall -q packages/order_core services/checkout services/billing services/inventory`
7. Run focused tests: `pytest -q tests/order_rules tests/checkout/test_totals.py tests/billing/test_invoices.py`
8. Review final diff: `git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat`
